name: The Weave
description: The Weave is the magical network around everything. Using energy produces a brief flash in which the surrounding magic can be seen, and ley lines are dense concentrations of it.

log.summary: Elrus explains the Weave to Walker and treats it as basic knowledge Walker should already have.

log.summary: Mahali describes the Weave as a term summarizing what magic is: an interconnected magical field or sea whose strings casters pull on. Each type of caster accesses it differently: wizards through study, ingredients, and incantations; sorcerers by being born with it; bards through their voices; and druids by their own means. When combined with belief, the Weave forms deities.
